profile.summary: The Oakland Education Association is the labor union that represents nearly 3,000 teachers, counselors, nurses, psychologists, librarians, speech pathologists, social workers and teacher substitutes in Oakland Unified School District's K-12, early childhood and adult education programs. It is affiliated with the Alameda Labor Council, the California Teachers Association and the National Education Association.

sources.title: Who We Are - Oakland Education Association
